evidence_type: static REA observations bound to original IL2CPP v31 bytes
limitations: No game execution or runtime callback order observation.
Decompiler text can include inlined callees and followed tail calls; references are not all direct caller edges.
A shared native address retains all metadata aliases; a seed label alone does not prove the receiver type.
Raw E8 patterns only corroborate decompiler targets within the selected PE unwind range; instruction boundaries are not independently decoded here.
TypeInfo usage tags and registered fields give static identity/layout, not current runtime values.
NPC model serialized sources and selected prefab/component references are separately bound in assets/npc-model-wiring.json. Decompiled branches are not observed runtime model choices.

component_registration_inventory.boundary: All registered MethodSpec entries for these two metadata method definitions, plus exact ASCII prefix searches over the pinned native file. Generic variables, System.Object, non-generic Type calls, reflection, dynamic construction and external/Mod code remain possible. Missing concrete receiver instantiation or ICall text is not a global proof of no runtime addition/replacement.

operation_inventory_boundary: ICall resolution sites and encoded MethodSpec usages in selected saved bodies. A usage can be initialization metadata rather than an executed call; arguments/branches require the full body. Absence is not a global negative search.
scope: Selected NPC factory, avatar choice, animation receiver addition/initialization and controller replacement paths
